name: smwsprites-beezo-giant-beezo
title: Beezo + Giant Beezo
description:
The flying masked creature from SMB2 that flies straightforward like Eeries do, can be ridden on and be carried. Extra bit determines if it'll be a normal or a giant Beezo.

This sprite was part of mikeyk's SMB2 Updated sprites pack, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.
